title: Recurring
lead_one: I found <c>{{count}} charge</c> that comes every month.
lead_other: I found <c>{{count}} charges</c> that come every month.
leadNoRise: None of them went up in the latest month.
rule: I count a membership as a subscription when it comes from the same merchant two months in a row with little change in price. Places you often spend at, such as supermarkets, restaurants and food delivery, are not here; they are on Spending and in the suggestions.

leadTotals: I found {{subs}} and {{bills}} every month. Your subscriptions cost <c>{{subTotal}}</c> a month; your bills came to <m>{{billTotal}}</m> last month.
subscriptionsIntro: Memberships with the same price every month. If the price changed, type the new amount; if you cancelled, mark it.
billsIntro: Electricity, water, gas, internet and phone. The amount changes from month to month.
billRule: I count a bill as regular once it comes two months in a row; a changing amount does not matter.
